meta.name: Punch Punch Forever!
meta.description: Gogo Matsumoto, an 11-year old aloof martial arts prodigy, along with her half-demon older sister; Nono, her mama; Mama, and her cool pet frog; Coolfrog, embark to compete in a martial arts tournament that pits humans against a near-infinite barrage of demons from another realm called the Akumugai. If a human can come out triumphant, they will be granted a wish from the Akumugai's warlord, Emperor Koro. Can Gogo overcome this impossibe challenge?

videos.title: Pilot

If a human can come out triumphant, they will be granted a wish from the Akumugai's warlord, Emperor Koro. Can Gogo overcome this impossibe challenge? If so, will she wish for a big, like REALLY big hambrguger? I hope so!

videos.title: My Little Slasher
videos.overview: Even when trying to go for a relaxing camp out in the woods, the Matsumoto family is bitterly reminded that opponents in the Infinite Tournament can pounce at any place and any time. well that flippin' stinks.

videos.title: Toothless Aggression
videos.overview: Emperor Koro commissions the iconic Demon Wrestling Federation tag team twin duo, "The Nabe Brothers", to compete in his Infinite Tournament and break Mama's legs!

videos.title: Holes Of Glory
videos.overview: As the humans have been surviving this years Infinite Tournament much longer than usual, they are forced to compete in a deadly gameshow obstacle course to ensure their numbers are rapidly cut down.

videos.title: Christmas Panic!
videos.overview: Gogo and Nono help spread holiday cheer when a big fat fellow donned in red crosses their path... who could it be? who??? aahhhhghhhh
